text: Assumption: In case of kNotConcurrent, Diagnostic Management serializes method calls internally — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: In case of kNotConcurrent, Diagnostic Management serializes method calls internally — is this correct?
norm: in case of knotconcurrent diagnostic management serializes method calls internally
assumption: In case of kNotConcurrent, Diagnostic Management serializes method calls internally.
rationale: This is the necessary logical consequence of the restriction that parallel calls are only permitted in case of kConcurrent.

original.text: Annahme: Bei kNotConcurrent serialisiert das Diagnostic Management die Methodenaufrufe vermutlich intern — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Bei kNotConcurrent serialisiert das Diagnostic Management die Methodenaufrufe vermutlich intern
original.rationale: Dies ist die notwendige logische Konsequenz der Einschränkung, dass parallele Aufrufe nur bei kConcurrent gestattet sind.
